Search summaries cite an Oct 2025 shutdown announcement (company LinkedIn post; WBJournal/Boston Business Journal) but those pages returned 403 / were not opened, so only the auction listing is cited. Revised after audit (D-018): status unconfirmed - the only fetched evidence is an auction listing, which shows a closed battery manufacturer but no commercial cell output, so status is null at confidence 0.4 (v1 'operational' not supported). project_state cancelled = closed/liquidated; installed_capacity_gwh null (last producing capacity: no source states one; Ambri's own plan for the never-finished Milford plant was 200,000 cells/yr per a search snippet, not cited). Nameplate/start/announced nulled: no source for any figure (v1 had none; v1 announced_year 2022 unconfirmed - the Marlborough plant opened 2013 per search results, the 2022-23 announcement was the planned Milford factory which was never completed). Basis note: the enum has no 'closed'; cancelled used per CONVENTIONS (bankrupt without buyer).
